root_cause.text: The function ti_am335x_xbar_route_allocate() obtains a device reference via of_find_device_by_node() but never releases it with put_device(), leading to a reference leak on every call.
root_cause.evidence: The patch adds a common exit label that calls put_device(&pdev->dev) and redirects all return paths to it, ensuring the leaked reference is dropped. The commit message explicitly states "fix device leak on am335x route allocation".

intent_record.intent_summary: Fix device reference leak on error paths in ti_am335x_xbar_route_allocate by using goto-based cleanup.
intent_record.what: Changed early return statements to goto cleanup label, initialized map to ERR_PTR(-EINVAL), and added out_put_pdev label to call put_device on pdev before returning map.
intent_record.how: This ensures that the device reference obtained from of_find_device_by_node is released on all error paths, preventing a reference leak. The function now always calls put_device before returning an error pointer.

intent_record.intent_summary: Fix device reference leak by adding put_device before returning.
intent_record.what: Added a label 'out_put_pdev:' and a call to put_device(&pdev->dev) before the return statement in the ti_am335x_xbar_route_allocate function.
intent_record.how: The function now releases the reference to the platform device (pdev) acquired earlier, preventing a reference count leak on the successful code path.
